reason: Internal enforcement only, issue #187 findings 2-4: a test proving the Relevance Gate's shipped instruction (participation.md) is not degenerate; nora/skills/loader.py now refuses a skill whose frontmatter carries authority_above, authority_below or change_policy (nothing reads any of the three for a skill), and both shipped skills had those keys removed -- a gate-time refusal (strict SkillStore, the test suite and nora-land's gate), not a runtime one, since the live agent loads skills through Strands' own AgentSkills(strict=False) and the portal's non-strict read drops a keyed skill silently; and the skill-body size guard still counts cl100k tokens (ADR 0016 §4) but now on the body with whitespace collapsed first, because a raw token count is still gameable by rewrapping the same text (measured and proved by a new test, including one that loads real SKILL.md files through the production loader).
